text: A correction after dispatch must be keyed by DELIVERY ID, not by the DR. The pair (destination, DR) is not unique in this tenant - DR 434 arrived at one branch from two different senders, and the lookup takes ORDER BY id DESC, so a sender correcting by DR rewrites whichever row is newest. Pass the id and VERIFY the destination+DR against it instead of searching. The received guard is the owner's line: a received dispatch is the branch's evidence, so the sender is refused (ALREADY_RECEIVED) and only admin may pass. Before building a sender-side edit, check what already exists: the cashier's add-missing-products path and the admin both-sides sync were already implemented in dl_correctDeliveryByDr, so only the origin-keyed entry point was missing. Two traps: an on-hand-only cap refuses the quantity on the paper DR because the dispatched stock has already left (allowance = remaining + already dispatched), and any delivery line absent from the payload is ZEROED, so a product that fell off the sheet because this dispatch spent it must be injected or the correction silently erases it.
